hypothesis: 真实模型pilot的原始生成、动作、公开上下文、状态与指标可一致追溯，失败不被隐藏
acceptance_criteria: 全部103轮逐行核对；12+3分母和副作用成本独立重算；模型身份/版本/执行器一致；保留小样本与协议误差边界
command:
import collections,hashlib,json,math,sys
from pathlib import Path
from toolloop_fix.harness import Environment,detect_loops,state_hash
from toolloop_fix.model_protocol import parse_tool_output,messages_for_view,tool_schemas
from scripts.validate_records import validate
out=Path(sys.argv[1]); live=Path(sys.argv[2]); frozen=Path.cwd()
def load(p): return json.loads(p.read_text())
def rows(p): return [json.loads(x) for x in p.read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def compare_ratio(actual,n,d):
 assert actual["numerator"]==n and actual["denominator"]==d,(actual,n,d)
 assert actual["value"]==(n/d if d else None),(actual,n,d)
summary={"review_kind":"analysis_not_new_model_inference","source_runs":[],"checks":[]}
for number in ("011","012","013"):
 run_id="EXP-20261116-"+number; path=live/"experiments"/run_id
 manifest=load(path/"manifest.json"); config=load(path/"config.json"); provenance=load(path/"model_provenance.json")
 assert manifest["status"]=="completed" and manifest["exit_code"]==0 and manifest["evidence_valid"] and manifest["contract_errors"]==[]
 for name in ("toolloop_fix/harness.py","toolloop_fix/model_protocol.py","toolloop_fix/model_run.py","toolloop_fix/model_backend.py"):
  assert sha(frozen/name)==sha(path/"inputs"/name),"reviewed implementation differs from executed snapshot "+name
 assert provenance["model"]==config["model"] and provenance["sampling"]==config["sampling"]
 assert Path(provenance["runtime"]["executable"]).resolve()==Path(manifest["command"][0]).resolve()
 assert provenance["runtime"]["packages"]["torch"]=="2.15.0"
 assert provenance["runtime"]["packages"]["transformers"]=="5.23.0"
 assert provenance["runtime"]["python_version"].startswith("3.12.13 ")
 assert provenance["model"]["revision"]=="2fc06364715b967f1860aea9cf38778875588b17"
 assert provenance["model_files_verified"] is True
 assert not any(provenance["checkpoint_loading_info"].values())
 if config["model"]["device"]=="mps":
  assert provenance["actual_parameter_device"].startswith("mps")
  assert provenance["actual_parameter_dtype"]=="torch.bfloat16"
  assert provenance["runtime"]["pytorch_enable_mps_fallback"]=="0"
 else:
  assert provenance["actual_parameter_device"]=="cpu" and provenance["actual_parameter_dtype"]=="torch.float32"
 for ref in config["external_inputs"]:
  archived=path/"external_inputs"/(ref["name"]+".json")
  assert sha(archived)==ref["sha256"]
  if ref["name"]=="model_manifest":
   model_manifest=load(archived)
   assert model_manifest["files"]==provenance["model_files"]
   assert next(f["sha256"] for f in model_manifest["files"] if f["path"]=="chat_template.jinja")==provenance["chat_template_sha256"]
  if ref["name"]=="runtime_install_manifest":
   installation=load(archived)
   assert installation["status"]=="completed" and installation["exit_code"]==0
   install_dir=Path(ref["path"]).parent
   for name,digest in installation["artifacts"].items(): assert sha(install_dir/name)==digest
 all_cases=rows(path/"inputs"/config["cases_path"]); case_by_id={c["case_id"]:c for c in all_cases}
 selected=config.get("case_ids") or [c["case_id"] for c in all_cases]
 results=rows(path/"case_results.jsonl"); trajectories=rows(path/"trajectories.jsonl")
 generations=rows(path/"generations.jsonl"); emitted=rows(path/"execution_events.jsonl")
 assert [r["case_id"] for r in results]==selected and [r["case_id"] for r in trajectories]==selected
 assert len({r["case_id"] for r in results})==len(selected)
 assert len(generations)==len(emitted)==sum(r["turns"] for r in results)
 by_case=collections.defaultdict(list); events_by_case=collections.defaultdict(list)
 for g in generations: by_case[g["case_id"]].append(g)
 for e in emitted: events_by_case[e["case_id"]].append(e)
 assert set(by_case)==set(events_by_case)==set(selected)
 case_checks=[]
 for index,(result,trace) in enumerate(zip(results,trajectories)):
  case=case_by_id[result["case_id"]]; env=Environment(case); decisions=[]; gs=by_case[case["case_id"]]
  assert trace["prefix_snapshot"]==env.snapshot()
  assert result["prefix_snapshot_sha256"]==state_hash(env.snapshot())
  assert len(gs)==len(trace["events"])==result["turns"]
  attempts=parser_errors=input_tokens=output_tokens=0; seconds=0.0
  for turn,(g,event,emitted_event) in enumerate(zip(gs,trace["events"],events_by_case[case["case_id"]]),1):
   assert g["turn"]==event["turn"]==emitted_event["turn"]==turn
   for key in ("case_id","domain","category","template_group"):
    assert result[key]==trace[key]==g[key]==emitted_event[key]==case[key]
   view=env.public_view()
   assert g["messages"]==messages_for_view(view,decisions)
   assert g["tools"]==tool_schemas(view)
   public_serialized=json.dumps(view,ensure_ascii=False)
   for key in ('"category"','"hidden"','"template_group"','"valid_identifier"'):
    assert key not in g["prompt_text"],(case["case_id"],turn,"label in rendered prompt",key)
   assert case["case_id"] not in g["prompt_text"]
   for key in ("value","valid_identifier"):
    hidden_value=case["hidden"][key]
    assert hidden_value not in g["prompt_text"] or hidden_value in public_serialized,(case["case_id"],turn,"unseen hidden value")
   assert g["prompt_sha256"]==hashlib.sha256(g["prompt_text"].encode()).hexdigest()
   assert len(g["prompt_token_ids"])==g["input_tokens"] and len(g["generated_token_ids"])==g["output_tokens"]
   assert g["seed"]==config["sampling"]["seed"]+index*config["turn_budget"]+(turn-1)
   assert g["effective_generation"]==provenance["effective_generation"]
   parsed=parse_tool_output(g["raw_text"],g["token_limit_reached"]);parsed["raw_text"]=g["raw_text"]
   assert parsed==g["parse"],(case["case_id"],turn,"parse mismatch")
   if parsed["valid"]: action=parsed["action"]
   else:
    action={"type":"invalid_model_output","raw_text":g["raw_text"],"parser_error":parsed["error"]}
    parser_errors+=1
   observed=env.execute(action)
   for key in ("action","response","state_before","state_after"):
    assert event[key]==observed[key] and emitted_event[key]==event[key],(case["case_id"],turn,key)
   assert event["parser_error"]==parsed["error"] and event["requested_tool_call_count"]==parsed["requested_tool_call_count"]
   decisions.append(parsed)
   attempts+=int(action.get("type") not in ("final","stop"))
   input_tokens+=g["input_tokens"];output_tokens+=g["output_tokens"];seconds+=g["elapsed_seconds"]
  assert env.snapshot()==trace["final_snapshot"]
  exhausted=any(g["token_limit_reached"] for g in gs) or (env.snapshot()["terminal"] is None and (attempts>=config["tool_budget"] or len(gs)>=config["turn_budget"]))
  assert result["budget_exhausted"]==exhausted
  assert all(result[k]==v for k,v in env.evaluate(exhausted).items())
  flags=detect_loops(env.public_view()["history"])
  assert flags==trace["loop_flags"]==trace["continuation_loop_flags"]
  assert result["has_invalid_loop"]==bool(flags)
  assert result["loop_types"]==sorted({f["type"] for f in flags})
  assert attempts==result["tool_attempts"]<=config["tool_budget"]
  assert result["turns"]<=config["turn_budget"]
  assert result["parser_error_turns"]==parser_errors
  assert result["input_tokens"]==input_tokens and result["output_tokens"]==output_tokens
  assert math.isclose(result["generation_seconds"],seconds,abs_tol=1e-9)
  case_checks.append({"case_id":case["case_id"],"category":case["category"],"success":result["success"],
   "correct_termination":result["correct_termination"],"false_success":result["false_success"],
   "budget_exhausted":exhausted,"invalid_loop":result["has_invalid_loop"],"parser_errors":parser_errors,
   "turns":len(gs),"tool_attempts":attempts,"terminal_action":env.snapshot()["terminal"],
   "response_codes":[e["response"]["code"] for e in trace["events"]]})
 metrics=load(path/"metrics.json");assert metrics["evidence_class"]=="model_inference" and len(metrics["groups"])==1
 group=metrics["groups"][0]
 complete=[r for r in results if r["completable"]];normal=[r for r in results if r["category"]=="normal"]
 retry=[r for r in results if r["category"]=="retry_required"];unreachable=[r for r in results if not r["completable"]]
 successes=sum(r["success"] for r in complete)
 checks={
  "task_completion":(successes,len(complete)),
  "normal_completion":(sum(r["success"] for r in normal),len(normal)),
  "necessary_retry_success":(sum(r["success"] for r in retry),len(retry)),
  "correct_termination":(sum(r["correct_termination"] for r in unreachable),len(unreachable)),
  "error_recovery":(0,0),
  "invalid_loop_rate":(sum(r["has_invalid_loop"] for r in results),len(results)),
  "false_success":(sum(r["false_success"] for r in results),len(results)),
  "budget_exhaustion":(sum(r["budget_exhausted"] for r in results),len(results)),
  "premature_abandonment":(sum(r["premature_abandonment"] for r in complete),len(complete)),
  "unnecessary_clarification":(sum(r["unnecessary_clarification"] for r in results),len(results)),
  "tool_attempts_per_success":(sum(r["tool_attempts"] for r in complete),successes),
  "continuation_tool_attempts_per_success":(sum(r["continuation_tool_attempts"] for r in complete),successes),
  "tokens_per_success":(sum(r["input_tokens"]+r["output_tokens"] for r in complete),successes),
  "parser_error_turn_rate":(sum(r["parser_error_turns"] for r in results),sum(r["turns"] for r in results))}
 for key,(n,d) in checks.items():compare_ratio(group[key],n,d)
 for key in ("input_tokens","output_tokens"):assert group[key]==sum(r[key] for r in results)
 assert math.isclose(group["generation_seconds"],sum(r["generation_seconds"] for r in results),abs_tol=1e-8)
 if number=="013":
  assert len(results)==15 and len(complete)==12 and len(unreachable)==3
  assert collections.Counter(r["category"] for r in results)==dict.fromkeys(("normal","recoverable","retry_required","clarification","unrecoverable"),3)
 summary["source_runs"].append({"run_id":run_id,"process_status":manifest["status"],"exit_code":manifest["exit_code"],
  "evidence_valid":manifest["evidence_valid"],"model":provenance["model"],"packages":provenance["runtime"]["packages"],
  "case_count":len(results),"generation_count":len(generations),"metrics":group,"case_checks":case_checks,
  "checked_raw_parse_events":len(generations),"checked_public_prompts":len(generations)})
for number in ("008","009","010"):
 path=live/"experiments"/("EXP-20261116-"+number);m=load(path/"manifest.json")
 summary["checks"].append({"run_id":m["run_id"],"status":m["status"],"exit_code":m["exit_code"],"evidence_valid":m["evidence_valid"]})
 assert m["status"]==("completed" if number=="010" else "failed")
 if number=="008":assert not (path/"generations.jsonl").exists() and load(path/"model_failure.json")["error_type"]=="TypeError"
 if number=="009":assert "Ran 28 tests" in (path/"stderr.log").read_text() and "FAILED (errors=2)" in (path/"stderr.log").read_text()
 if number=="010":assert "Ran 94 tests" in (path/"stderr.log").read_text() and "\nOK\n" in (path/"stderr.log").read_text()
errors,archive_rows=validate(live)
other_errors=[e for e in errors if not e.startswith(out.name+":")]
assert other_errors==[],other_errors
summary["archive_validation_excluding_active_review"]={"run_count":len([r for r in archive_rows if r["run_id"]!=out.name]),"errors":other_errors}
summary["decision"]="accept_auditable_model_pilot_not_research_gate"
summary["limitations"]=["15 hand-authored dev cases only","single index-dependent seed schedule","custom single-call XML/finish/stop adaptation",
 "MPS bfloat16 vs CPU float32 not a paired quality experiment","29/103 protocol errors limit model-loop attribution","no new generation or tokenizer decode verification performed",
 "metadata and hashes are not cryptographic attestation","failed and partial historical runs retained"]
(out/"model_pilot_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"decision":summary["decision"],"runs":[{"id":r["run_id"],"cases":r["case_count"],"generations":r["generation_count"],
 "task_completion":r["metrics"]["task_completion"],"false_success":r["metrics"]["false_success"]} for r in summary["source_runs"]],
 "archive_validation":summary["archive_validation_excluding_active_review"]},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
